name: Stock News Analysis
desc: Combines real-time news sentiment from major outlets with technical indicators to improve short-term stock price prediction using machine learning by integrating LLM-based sentiment scoring with XGBoost models.

name: Credit Score Analysis/Prediction
desc: Developed a cashflow-based credit scoring model to assess defaultrisk for ‘credit invisible’ consumers lacking traditional credit histories.

name: Farmer Q&A Analysis
desc: Analyzed 1.5M+ farmer Q&A records using NLP and visual analytics to uncover crop-specific vs. general information needs, revealing topic gaps, repetitive demand, and seasonal patterns across regions to better align agricultural knowledge supply with farmer needs

name: Violent Crimes Comparison
desc: Interactive website which allows users to compare violent crime statistics across different US cities using data visualizations like bar charts and line graphs to identify trends and patterns over time

name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Analysis
desc: Interactive Dashboard analyzing global greenhouse gas emissions data from 1990 to 2020, featuring visualizations like line charts and heatmaps to explore trends by country and sector, aiding in understanding and addressing climate change.

name: Spotify Song Popularity Prediction
desc: Built a Spotify song popularity predictor by analyzing large-scale audio and metadata features and training a custom PyTorch neural network, achieving 85% prediction accuracy in identifying drivers of hit songs.

name: Wordle Guesser
desc: Optimally solves the daily Wordle using word frequency analysis, web scraping, and Python coding techniques.
